## Type of change

- [ ] `feat` — new feature
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `chore` — tooling, deps, CI
- [ ] `refactor` — no behaviour change

## Area

- [ ] Frontend
- [ ] Backend / API
- [ ] Database / schema
- [ ] Docs / product copy
- [ ] CI/CD / tooling

## How was it tested?

<!-- Commands you ran and what you observed. -->

```bash
npm test -w backend
npm run build -w frontend
```

## Checklist

- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and the [Code of Conduct](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
- [ ] No secrets, `.env` contents, or API keys are included.
- [ ] No hardcoded demo data is shipped on production paths.
- [ ] Tests added/updated where behaviour changed.
- [ ] `npm test -w backend` passes.
- [ ] `npm run build -w frontend` passes.
- [ ] Docs (`README.md` / `CONNECTION.md`) updated if the API or schema changed.
- [ ] At least one teammate has been requested for review (see [CODEOWNERS](./CODEOWNERS)).
